verdicts.reason: Both are the same weak banner. The headline is centred in the left third, leaving about 170px of dead space on the left and a wide empty gap before a tiny cat cluster pushed to the far right edge, so the two halves don't read as one composition. The cats, the original's hero image, are shrunk to a thumbnail and clipped at the bottom. In A the cat group is even smaller and narrower, so it is less legible. B's slightly larger cats fill the height a little better, which makes it marginally the less bad of the two.
